people.name: Daniel Park
people.replyTime: Usually replies within a few hours

listings.title: Engracia Sequin Maxi Dress
listings.description: Burgundy satin maxi dress with a sequin-embellished bust, thin adjustable straps and a side zip. The satin has no stretch, so go by your usual size. Worn once to a holiday party.
listings.careNotes: I hand wash it between rentals. Please don't wash or spot clean it yourself — just tell me about any marks at return.

listings.title: Lyricah Tiered Tie Back Maxi Dress
listings.description: Deep plum maxi dress in a burnout floral fabric, with a V-neckline, gathered bust, tiered skirt and a tie at the open back. Fully lined, with adjustable straps and a side zip. No stretch.
listings.careNotes: I wash it on a cold, gentle cycle between rentals. Please don't wash it yourself.

listings.title: Under The Pagoda Maxi Dress
listings.sizeNote: US 4 · the brand suggests sizing down
listings.description: Strapless maxi dress in Peppermayo's dark floral print, with the matching neck scarf included. Fully lined, with silicone taping along the neckline so it stays up and an invisible side zip.
listings.careNotes: Please keep the scarf with the dress. I clean both after each rental.

listings.title: Polo Soft Tailored Fit Linen Suit Jacket
listings.description: Dark navy linen suit jacket in Polo's soft tailored fit, with a notch lapel and a lightly structured shoulder. Pairs with the cream linen trousers in my closet for a summer wedding. Linen creases as you wear it; that's part of the look.
listings.careNotes: Dry clean only. Please don't attempt spot cleaning — tell me about any marks at return.

listings.title: Linen Suit Trouser
listings.description: Cream linen suit trousers with a straight leg. Wear them with the navy linen jacket from my closet, or on their own with a knit or a blazer as in the photo (only the trousers are included).
listings.careNotes: Dry clean only. Cream shows everything, so please mention any marks at return.

listings.title: Oren Silk Dress
listings.description: Strapless silk charmeuse dress with a straight neckline, an A-line skirt and a separate matching neck scarf, which is included. 100% silk, lined and not sheer, with elastic at the neckline and a relaxed fit throughout.
listings.careNotes: Dry clean only — it's silk, so no water or spot cleaning please. Keep the scarf with the dress.

listings.title: Hot Dog Costume
listings.description: One-piece hot dog costume with a mustard squiggle down the front. It pulls on over your own clothes; the black top and jeans in the photo aren't included.
listings.careNotes: Spot clean only. Please don't put it in the wash.

reviews.author: Hannah Weiss
reviews.text: Fit exactly as described and the satin photographs beautifully. Handoff took five minutes.

reviews.author: Aiko Tanaka
reviews.text: Spotless condition and the scarf was included. The lender let me try it first, which made all the difference.

reviews.author: Jordan Ellis
reviews.text: Gorgeous colour. Slightly long on me without heels, so plan your shoes.

reviews.author: Sam Whitfield
reviews.text: Sharp jacket, true to the listed size. Easy pickup in Old Town.

reviews.author: Hannah Weiss
reviews.text: Exactly what it looks like. Got laughs all night.
